fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: In GitHub (organization or repository Settings > Webhooks) set the Payload URL to https://<this site>/api/method/helpdesk.api.github.webhook, the content type to application/json, the same secret as below, and send Pull requests, Pull request reviews and Workflow runs.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Every delivery is checked against this secret; unsigned or wrongly signed requests are refused.

fields.label: Allowed Repositories
fields.description: One per line: owner/repo, or owner/* for every repository of that owner. Deliveries from other repositories are ignored.

fields.label: Complete the task when a closing PR is merged
fields.description: For PRs that say "Closes TASK-...". Projects that need review before done send the task to review instead.

fields.label: Project for PRs without a task
fields.description: A PR that names no task gets a new task here. Leave empty to notify System and Agent Managers instead.

fields.label: GitHub Token
fields.description: Optional. Lets TBO Support ask on a PR for its task number and read why a PR was closed. Needs read and write access to pull requests and issues.

fields.label: Org merge bot
fields.description: The merge bot merges PRs in both organisations that CodeRabbit approved and whose checks are green. GitHub doesn't reliably run it on its schedule, so TBO Support asks for a run when CodeRabbit approves a PR or a PR's CI passes, and every 10 minutes, at most once per 2 minutes. The merge rules stay in the bot.

fields.label: Trigger the org merge bot
fields.description: Needs the webhook at organization level in tbocloud and teambackoffice, also sending Pull request reviews, Check suites and Workflow runs.

fields.label: Merge bot workflow
fields.description: The workflow file name; it's run on main with dry_run off.

fields.label: Merge bot token
fields.description: Optional. A fine-grained token with Actions: Read and write on the merge bot repository only. Leave empty to use the GitHub Token above.

fields.label: Last outcome
fields.description: Last result as a fixed value, whatever the language, for Settings → GitHub.
